parsed.rationale: All 15 members are unnamed extensions on `View` (SwiftUI's standard type), spread across unrelated packages — WXUI, Wallpaper, PartyHorn, PlayerHeaderView, MusicShareKit, and app:iOS — each extending `View` to add domain-specific modifiers or helpers (e.g., `GlassEffect+Compatibility.swift`, `PlaybackBlendMode.swift`, `WipeDownRevealModifier.swift`). The cluster signal is purely a name-collision on the implicit `View` extension target, not a structural or semantic duplication. Every `fields_or_signature` list is empty, so there is no shared member evidence to consolidate. Collapsing these extensions would couple unrelated packages and violate the intentional modular boundary each package maintains.
